description: This file is a PHP source file for a module in the vtiger CRM system, specifically handling the display and retrieval of related records for the Campaign module, such as call-related lists.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering the CRM interface.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Core CRM entity class used to retrieve and manage entity data.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific entity record.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related modules' data associated with the current record.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module to the user session for display management.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves the list of related modules stored in the session.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Fetches the sequence field configuration for the module, if any.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific fields within modules.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information for a record, such as last modified details.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Determines the status or permissions for interface buttons.
